items.information: COVID-19 SAFETY INFORMATION: We are requiring masks for all competitors and their guests in the venue throughout the day. venue.address: Alameda Praia de Atalaia 450, Stella Maris, Salvador

items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Em virtude do COVID-19, o local só irá comportar um número máximo de 25 competidores e 25 convidados; 7. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (blima@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 25 competitors and 25 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br), or the delegate via email (blima@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.name: Three Rounds Whangarei 2022
items.information: Three Rounds Whangarei 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: **ESTA SERÁ LA TERCERA COMPETENCIA OFICIAL REALIZADA EN EL ESTADO DE SAN LUIS POTOSÍ.** ¡Estamos muy emocionados de anunciar Tunas Open 2022! Únete a nosotros en un increíble fin de semana de cubos y diversión en la histórica ciudad de San Luis Potosí. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender [el reglamento de la WCA ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) antes de la competencia. Antes de registrarse, debe leer todas las pestañas. Estas pestañas detallan las responsabilidades de todos los competidores durante esta competencia. **THIS WILL BE THE THIRD OFFICIAL COMPETITION HELD IN THE STATE OF SAN LUIS POTOSÍ.** We are very excited to announce Tunas Open 2022! Join us for an amazing weekend of cubing and fun in historic San Luis Potosí City. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2t) Before registering, you must read all tabs. items.name: Vení a Cubear a Toto 2022

venue.name: [Casa de la Cultura Totonicapense](https://www.facebook.com/Casa-de-la-Cultura-Totonicapense-106264447404415/)
venue.address: 8va Avenida entre 2da y tercera calle, zona 1, Totonicapán

items.information: "Vení a Cubear" será la primera competencia en este departamento. Se tendrán protocolos de bioseguridad por pandemia y los requeridos por la WCA, para permitir la realización de competencias con el mejor ambiente posible. Deberá usarse mascarilla todo el tiempo, habrá alcohol en gel y se tomará la temperatura al registrarse. Se aceptará como máximo un acompañante por competidor. "Vení a Cubear" will be the first competition on that region. There will be biosecurity protocols due to the pandemia, and those required by the WCA as well, to allow a good environment while holding competitions. Use of face mask is mandatory all day, also there will be gel alcohol and temperature will be measured at the entrance. A maximum of one guest will be allowed for each competitor.
